name: Metropolis of Libertopolis
author: N. M. Felker
description: A soaring Art Deco cyberpunk metropolis powered by subterranean fusion reactors, elevated monorails, and stark divides between the gleaming Spire District and the rain-slicked Neon Canyon.

districts.name: Spaceport Sub-Orbital Complex
districts.description: High-capacity launch complexes, sub-orbital freight pads, and drone freight staging for interplanetary logistics.

districts.name: Fusion Core Sector
districts.description: General Dynamics subterranean tokamak reactors, cryogenic coolant manifolds, and primary energy transmission spines.

districts.name: Rust Belt Industrial Basin
districts.description: Automated drone factories, heavy machining foundries, river loading slips, and legacy manufacturing blocks.

districts.name: West Frontier Zone
districts.description: Outer autonomous residential settlements, scrap salvagers, unlicensed talleres, and climate refugee perimeter blocks.

districts.name: Residential Stacks & Conduit Commons
districts.description: Massive 40-story residential megablocks, external utility conduit webs, dense working-class tenements, and local skywalks.

districts.name: Neon Canyon Entertainment & Commercial Core
districts.description: Damp multi-tier urban ravines, pulsing holographic marquees, noodle bars, Malone Investigations, and 24-hour underground markets.

districts.name: Biofab District & Kepler Complex
districts.description: Genomic synthesis facilities, Kepler Institute neuro-pharma labs, Libertopolis General Hospital, and automated medical cleanrooms.

districts.name: Spire District (Corporate Heights)
districts.description: Gleaming chrome supertalls, NexusCorp global headquarters, executive sky-penthouses, and private security aero-pads.

districts.name: Gilded Village Enclave
districts.description: Ultra-wealthy residential enclave, gated neoclassical villas, robotic manicured gardens, and exclusive private clubs.

districts.name: University District & Archives
districts.description: Grand Library and City Archives, faculty quadrangles, student housing cooperatives, and high-energy physics lecture halls.

districts.name: Stellar City Modernist Sector
districts.description: Futuristic mid-density residential arcologies, solar-glazed terraces, elevated pedestrian promenades, and civic transit nodes.

districts.name: Civic Center & Downtown Plaza
districts.description: Art Deco Libertopolis City Hall, grand judicial colosseum, municipal archives skybridge, and historic premier hotels.

districts.name: Atomsville Sub-Atomic District
districts.description: Enormous subterranean circular particle ring arena, quantum research institutes, engineer housing blocks, and high-flux laboratories.

districts.name: Aetherburg Commuter Borough
districts.description: Historic brick walkups, working family apartments, artisan workshops, corner bistros, and dense monorail commuter stops.

districts.name: Glitch District & River Bend
districts.description: Electromagnetic interference zone, black-market modder stalls, rogue AI hardware recycling, and makeshift neon dive bars.

districts.name: Lower East Side Waterfront
districts.description: High-density tenements, canal slips, cargo docks, fish markets, and multi-tier pedestrian bazaar walkways.

districts.name: Farmington Agricultural Buffer
districts.description: Hydroponic greenhouse domes, vertical aeroponic silos, dairy synthesis tanks, and peripheral agro-transport depots.

buildings.name: NexusCorp Executive Monolith
buildings.notes: Headquarters of NexusCorp. Towering 64 stories of reinforced chrome and polarized glass.

buildings.name: Libertopolis Municipal Palace
buildings.notes: City Hall featuring grand Art Deco facades and the executive mayoral suite.

buildings.name: Grand Library of Libertopolis
buildings.notes: Central archives repository storing pre-digital print collections.

buildings.name: Libertopolis General Hospital Complex
buildings.notes: Premier municipal hospital with trauma centers and hidden research wings.

buildings.name: Atomsville Synchrotron Collider Arena
buildings.notes: Massive circular particle accelerator facility and tech demonstration stadium.

buildings.name: Conduit Commons Block 7
buildings.notes: Sophie Striker's residence. Dense 42-story tenement block wrapped in high-voltage wiring.

buildings.name: Canyon Arcade Walkup (Malone Investigations)
buildings.notes: Historic 8-story commercial building housing Rex Malone's private detective agency.

pois.name: Malone Investigations
pois.description: Third floor office of private eye Rex Malone. Cramped, smelling of damp wool, with an Art Deco view over the neon canyon.

pois.name: The Electric Chair Bar
pois.description: Gus's dive bar tucked between a black-market circuit shop and an off-world noodle kiosk. Home of bitter beer and QuickSober.

pois.name: Sophie Striker's Apartment (Conduit Commons)
pois.description: Worn residential block covered in snaking utility conduits. Scene of the uncanny android substitution investigation.

pois.name: Sal's Monorail Coffee Kiosk
pois.description: Greasy platform kiosk serving notoriously burnt coffee where the early signs of robotic replacement were first spotted.

pois.name: Libertopolis City Hall
pois.description: Grand Art Deco municipal headquarters. Site of the dramatic mayoral suite confrontation with the Sterling interface unit.

pois.name: Grand Library & City Archives
pois.description: Pre-digital physical document depository connected via the third-floor skybridge where Luke Delaney's staff records were preserved.

pois.name: Libertopolis General (Kepler Secret Wing)
pois.description: Restricted subterranean medical wing holding the suspended stasis pods of replaced city officials and Sophie Striker.

pois.name: NexusCorp Monolith Spire
pois.description: Corporate headquarters of NexusCorp, creators of the Harmony robotic series and orchestrators of the municipal calculation.

pois.name: Atomsville Sub-Atomic Ring Arena
pois.description: Massive colosseum structure surrounding the high-flux synchrotron collider and theoretical energy testing grounds.
